incoming: Uin=eta*r0*g((t+x/c)/D), x(r0)=0; Ut=c*Ux. At t=0 support is outside the star,0<x<cD.
potential: U=Uin+L(Uin)+remainder; L=-Gret V. If norm(L)<=etaV<1, norm(remainder)<=etaV^2/(1-etaV)*norm(Uin). This is conditional on that operator bound, not a physical EOS certificate.
physical_scope: Initial scalar Cauchy packet on the same frozen nonzero background, not an applied thermal source, static parameter fit or companion-matched orbital input.
stable_lapse: zeta=delta_nu-delta_lambda=-integral_r^r0 K_lapse*f dr-exterior_integral; K_lapse=2*Phi/b+4*pi*r*A4/b*[r*Phi*(3Pg-Eg-Er-Kg+R4)+alpha*(7Pg-Eg-3Kg)]. Integration by parts removes the large r*Phi*f_prime endpoint cancellation.

lapse.null_characteristics: dr/dt=c*a*mu/h; dmu/dt=(1-mu^2)*[c*a/h*(R_prime/R-a_prime/a)+mu*(R_t/R-h_t/h)]; dln(epsilon)/dt=-c*mu*a_prime/h-(h_t/h)*mu^2-(R_t/R)*(1-mu^2). Derived from the null Hamiltonian with zero shift.
lapse.variables: Fixed Einstein radius: a=A*N, h=A/sqrt(b), R=A*r. zeta=delta_nu-delta_lambda; f=delta_phi; u=alpha*f. Existing frequency coordinate is Eref=a0(r)*epsilon.
lapse.lapse_packet: An exterior packet of Killing energy dE at(rp,mup) contributes(G*dE/c^4)*[integral(r0,rp) dr/(N*b^(3/2)*r^2)-mup^2/(rp*Np*sqrt(bp))] to delta_nu(r0), including its compensating interior mass debit.
lapse.scalar_lapse: delta_nu_scalar(r0)=+Phi(r0)*U(r0)-integral(r0,infinity)2*Phi*U/(r*b)dr, U=r*f. Additional vacuum J contributes -integral J/(r^2*b^2)dr.
lapse.limits: Algebra for the declared first variation; not a nonlinear stellar or angular-continuum certificate.
